title: Deep learning guided design of protease substrates
core_idea: Introduce CleaveNet, an end-to-end AI pipeline that pairs a multi-output sequence-to-function predictor with a generative peptide model to nominate and produce 10-mer peptide substrates either unconditionally or conditioned on desired protease cleavage profiles, with the goal of scaling, tuning, and accelerating in silico design and prioritization of protease substrates; applied to matrix metalloproteinases using mRNA-display data.
tldr: CleaveNet combines a deep-learning predictor and a conditional generator to design and prioritize peptide substrates for proteases, enabling scalable, tunable in silico substrate nomination across enzyme targets.
